description: Compare solar and propane camp showers on heat-up time, fuel use, weather, safety and cost to pick the right portable shower for your camping style.
directAnswer: Solar showers are cheap, light and fuel-free but give lukewarm water after 2 to 4 hours of sun. Propane showers heat water on demand in any weather, and one 1 pound cylinder can heat about 15 short showers.
